inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: The powers that be just rammed through Bill C-12, the so-called Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, with royal assent on March 26, 2026. Now they're deploying it to crack down on immigration and asylum claims from Nigerians and others. Ignore the official cover story about border security—that's pure misdirection. This is another clear case of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, zeroing in on targeted groups like Nigerians to advance their concealed agenda while flipping the whole thing around to look like necessary protection.
